question: SC-B7-13: does the fingerprint the app computes from a real stream's rows equal one computed from the server's rows?
method: A temporary test, appended to tests/e2e/b7-two-courses-live.spec.ts and removed after the run (source in live-fingerprint-diagnostic.txt). Two devices each made a course, one offline, and reached the choice over the real stream. With nothing unsent, each device's readCourseChoices() was compared with courseFingerprint() over the same 13 tables read through PostgREST.
notCovered: keep_course itself is not installed on this backend: the SQL's own hash is pinned to the app's by .evidence/B7/keep-rule-local-postgres.txt on a local Postgres, not on Supabase. Each course had 2 rows. tests/e2e/b7-two-courses-live.spec.ts still runs after B7-KEEP-RULE.
